title: Two image models, one price tag
subtitle: OpenAI shipped Flare and Sunburst on 8 Sep at identical token rates. Google charges double per image token.

tools.name: GPT Image 2.5 Flare
tools.price: $30 per 1M image output tokens; $5 text in, $8 image in.
tools.headline: OpenAI's fastest image model; low to max quality settings.
tools.context: Everyday, high-volume generation where speed wins.

tools.name: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
tools.price: Identical rates to Flare: $30 per 1M image output tokens.
tools.headline: Most capable for generation and editing, but slower.
tools.context: Edits and inpainting where precision matters most.

tools.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image
tools.price: $60 per 1M image output tokens; $0.067 per 1K image.
tools.headline: Nano Banana 2. Per-image cost published for 0.5K to 4K.
tools.context: Fast interactive work that needs per-image budgeting.
